title: Passive to Active Voice: More Practice — Quiz 113
content:
## Passive to Active Voice: More Practice

Change these revised classroom examples into active voice.

### Practice

1. Registration had been extended until Friday by the school.
2. The editor has been asked by the committee to revise a paragraph.
3. Every book will be labelled by December by the librarian.

### Understand the pattern

A past perfect passive uses had been + past participle; its active equivalent uses had + past participle. A present perfect passive uses has/have been. A future passive with will be becomes will plus the base verb.

### Worked answers and explanation

1. The school had extended registration until Friday.
2. The committee has asked the editor to revise a paragraph.
3. The librarian will label every book by December.

The practice sentences above use neutral classroom situations. Identify the agent before choosing the active subject.

### Try another

Change: The timetable had been revised by the principal.

### Suggested answer

The principal had revised the timetable. Removing been restores the active past-perfect form; had must remain.
